A field guide to remote meetings

Fewer meetings, shorter meetings, and meetings with a clear reason to exist.

Every meeting should answer one question before it is scheduled: what decision will we make together?

💡
If the answer is "none", send a written update instead.

Before the meeting

Share an agenda at least a day in advance and attach any documents people should read.

What if people do not read the documents?

Start with five minutes of silent reading. It feels odd at first, but it works.

After the meeting

Write down decisions and owners while everyone still remembers them.
